queries: GPT-5 router saves OpenAI compute costs

sources_considered.why: Contemporary analysis of the GPT-5 router as a cost measure. It shows savings were inferred, not disclosed.
The speaker's own writing; cannot be used as evidence for him.

receipt.public_excerpt: In theory, OpenAI's router model should allow the bulk of GPT-5's traffic to be served by its smaller, less resource-intensive models.

evidence_items.explanation: Analysts saw the router as a cost-saving design but described the savings 'in theory'. OpenAI had disclosed no figures. This fits the claim's uncertainty but does not settle any factual point.

unresolved_gaps: OpenAI has not published router-level cost data, so actual savings cannot be checked.
